title: GEI to mark new chapter with venue move for 19th edition
summary: Organisers of the Green Events & Innovations Conference (GEI) have announced the sustainability conference’s next chapter, revealing a move to London’s The O2 for its 19th edition next year. title: Contra Promotion launches gender-marginalised artist program
summary: German promoter Contra has launched a call for applications from early career female and gender-marginalised artists, in an effort to address gender balance across the live sector. Named ‘Claim Your Stage’, the scheme is searching for artists from FLINTA* communities, a German abbreviation referring to women, as well as lesbian, intersex, non-binary, transgender, and agender individuals. Led by Contra, the scheme is in co-operation with Summer Breeze Festival, Deichbrand, and Rock for People. summary: Calvin Harris has earned a Guinness World Record after drawing an estimated 1.6 million fans to a free performance in Brazil, setting a new bar for the largest attendance for a DJ set by a single artist. title: ‘World-class’ 10,000-cap arena proposed for Kenyan capital
summary: In a bid to bridge the infrastructure gap in Kenya, Pan-African developer The Zaria Group has revealed plans for a 10,000-seat, $294.5 million (€256.8m) multipurpose arena in the capital city, Nairobi. The Zaria Group is leading the project, with support from Dallas Mavericks president Masai Ujiri and investment vehicle Helios Sports & Entertainment. The Group is establishing a local subsidiary, Metroarena Development Company Ltd., to oversee its progress. title: Reeperbahn 2026 records growth in international reach
summary: Reeperbahn Festival has hailed growth in its status as an “international platform”, as the conference event reported a 20% jump in international speakers as part of a 10% increase in its industry participants at its 21st edition in Hamburg.
